create_vae_model: create an AutoencoderKLLTX2Video model from an LTXVideoVAEConfig for video encoding and decoding
encode_video_latents: encode a batch of video frames into latent representations using the VAE encoder
decode_latents_to_video: decode latent vectors back into video frames using the VAE decoder with optional timestep embeddings
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled VAE decoding to reduce memory usage for large spatial video dimensions
build_causal_conv3d: build a runtime-configurable causal 3D convolution layer for temporal video processing
